purpose: Compare a small fixed set of pre-outcome ADG predictors on identical nested leave-one-year-out rows, preserving v1 and the historical CGREC holdout unchanged.

source.population: CPER yearling steers only; retain all source Use.Flag categories.

prohibitions: Do not use source-reported ADG fields as predictors or targets.
Do not use any CGREC outcomes.

included: initial weight in kg, measured at the beginning of the season
excluded: exit weight, gain, derived ADG, and any post-outcome field
realized Season.Days: its availability at prediction time is not established
Treatment and Pasture: each treatment is represented by one remaining pasture, so these are aliased
Year, identity, source Use.Flag, and all group identifiers

groups.outer: Leave one of the five calendar years out; test all eligible rows in that year.
groups.inner: Within each outer training partition, leave each remaining year out in turn for fixed candidate hyperparameter selection.
groups.identityPurge: Within every split, exclude from training any row sharing Owner|Tag.Color|Tag with a test row. This is an identity proxy, not a verified permanent ID.
groups.comparisonRows: Every predictive candidate must emit exactly one prediction for each of the same 320 outer OOF source rows.

candidates.name: training_mean
candidates.fit: Arithmetic mean target in the current training partition.

candidates.name: OLS_initial_weight
candidates.fit: StandardScaler fitted on training rows then ordinary least squares.

candidates.name: Ridge_initial_weight
candidates.tuning: Select alpha in [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10] by equally weighted inner-year MAE; ties use smaller alpha.

candidates.name: Huber_initial_weight
candidates.tuning: Pipeline StandardScaler + HuberRegressor; select (epsilon, alpha) by equally weighted inner-year MAE over epsilon [1.1, 1.35, 1.5] x alpha [0.0001, 0.01]; ties use smaller epsilon then alpha.

candidates.name: shallow_random_forest_initial_weight
candidates.tuning: Select max_depth [2, 3] and min_samples_leaf [5, 10] by equally weighted inner-year MAE; 200 trees, bootstrap, random_state 20261013, n_jobs=1; ties use shallower depth then larger leaf.

candidates.name: shallow_hist_gradient_boosting_initial_weight
candidates.tuning: Select max_leaf_nodes [3, 5] and l2_regularization [1, 10] by equally weighted inner-year MAE; max_iter=50, learning_rate=0.05, min_samples_leaf=10, random_state 20261013; ties use fewer leaves then larger regularization.

mechanisticBenchmark.candidate: FarmEngine pasture/default setup with initial weight and each row's observed season duration
mechanisticBenchmark.use: Descriptive benchmark only: actual Season.Days is an outcome-period quantity and prediction-time planned horizon is not established. It cannot enter hyperparameter tuning, candidate selection, or advancement decisions.
mechanisticBenchmark.scaledVariant: For each outer fold, fit a non-negative zero-intercept multiplier on engine predictions for outer-training rows only, then report the held-year result; descriptive only and excluded from selection.
mechanisticBenchmark.rowMapping: Use source row initial weight and that same row's observed duration; preserve row identity. Confirm exact 320-row one-to-one mapping and fixed simulator configuration.

selectionRule: Development-only comparison. Report any candidate with lower pooled and year-macro MAE than M0, but make no promotion or external-validity claim; the outer folds have been examined in prior CPER diagnostics.

execution.measureCpu: Record aggregate fit and predict wall-clock seconds per candidate across inner tuning and outer refits; timings are descriptive and not expected to reproduce exactly.

prohibitions: Do not open, read, fit, tune, select, or report against CGREC outcomes.
Do not alter CPER candidate v1 or the frozen historical CGREC holdout.
Do not use realized duration, treatment, pasture, identity, year, or post-outcome values as ML features.
Do not interpret this single-site five-year internal development as validation or as evidence for mature cows, DMI, causal treatment effects, unseen pastures, or the complete simulator.
